extracted.name: Flaming Doctor Pepper
extracted.description: A Flaming Dr. Pepper is made with a shot of amaretto and high-proof rum, set alight, and dropped into a glass of beer for a sweet and fiery shooter.
instruction_lines: Fill a pint glass half full with beer.
Pour amaretto into a standard shot glass; pour rum on top so that it floats.
Light the shot on fire; carefully drop the lit shot into the half-full glass of beer and drink.
